name: dup-uid
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: creates an account that SHARES another account's UID (useradd -o), so two names map to one identity. Vars: USERNAME (required); CLONE_OF (optional, an existing user whose UID to copy) OR UID_NUM (explicit numeric UID). One of CLONE_OF/UID_NUM is required.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${USERNAME:?USERNAME is required}"
if [ -n "${CLONE_OF-}" ]; then
  uid=$(id -u "$CLONE_OF")
else
  uid="${UID_NUM:?UID_NUM or CLONE_OF is required}"
fi
if id "$USERNAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  usermod -o -u "$uid" "$USERNAME"
else
  useradd -m -o -u "$uid" -s /bin/bash "$USERNAME"
fi
